status: Partial stationary shooting-hazard checkpoint; full 653-record goal remains active and no record is newly certified complete.

native.basis: One complete final 46-suite run after clockwise rotation correction and the placement test distinction between scenery and a statue's own collider. Includes actual reachability of eight enabled identities. A later capture-only selector fix includes optional hazard residents; its native rebuild and actual seeded capture passed. No combat library changes followed the full native run.

browser.count_policy: 81 distinct cases in one complete final run: ten isolated hazard cases, two real seeded hazard rooms, and 69 earlier regressions. The interrupted preceding run and targeted runs are historical; they are not added to this count.

behavior.covered: Aimed/triple/ballistic volleys; actual explosion; first-tick clockwise flickering laser; fixed stream and Brimstone attacks; cardinal/diagonal alternation and explicit always-on phase policy; ordinary immunity; last actual foe triggers clear; retained inactive solids; plate objectives and persistent optional turrets; all plates required; immediate beam shutdown; re-entry and exceptional respawn without ordinary kill rewards; walking/flight/swept dodge/mouse navigation and actual projectile collision.
behavior.limits: Named instant-kill/on-hit/reroll items are not implemented by the generic execution flag. Source-exact cadence and some phase/re-entry exceptions remain open.

reachability.scope: Eight independent source-backed hazard identities occur in legal generated combat rooms; one optional hazard at most, separate from ordinary 4–14 actor budget. Persistent turrets get reachable optional plates; failed geometry placement is omitted. Both variant-11 always-on forms remain debug-only pending dedicated trap routing. No new hazards in band 0, the tutorial or Mine route.

configuration.scope: Bounded finite definitions and duplicate/unknown IDs rejected; only stationary noncontact independent hazards can use these controllers. External mode, clear policy, geometry, cadence, projectile and beam parameters, ballistic tuning, room chance and weighted band pools; immutable snapshots retained. Local tuning is distinguished from source numbers.

visuals.observation: Original-style stone bodies retain closed inactive faces, green Vomit stone and a visible rotating laser. Pressed plates turn teal; emitted projectiles retain their ordinary lifetime after shutdown. The actual seed 0/floor 3/room 8 view shows a turret and plate alongside five ordinary threats. Foreground canyon walls still obstruct some isolated views; procedural faces depend on viewing direction and a floor grate overlaps the seeded turret footprint visually. These captures are partial presentation evidence, not all-camera readability or human difficulty acceptance.
visuals.capture_provenance: Native/browser screenshots use actual game rendering. Screenshot FPS includes startup and other system activity; it is not a controlled performance measurement.

balance.scope: Damage/cadence/chance and subtype phase are declared local tuning. Ordinary 100-HP/24-damage defaults are preserved. No human or varied-build mixed-room acceptance.

performance.scope: Structural bounds only: one optional hazard per combat room, 120 candidate placements and 32 plate candidates, shared actor/projectile/hazard limits. Collision-list reconstruction scans resident actors each tick; no controlled current-roster Linux/WASM frame-time signoff.

failures_resolved: Initial compile used the wrong parser helper; corrected to real(row).
Initial EM_ASM object-literal commas failed WASM preprocessing; parenthesized the object expression.
Initial pacing test treated the statue own navigation body as conflicting scenery; the corrected check excludes movement bodies only for the stationary-hazard scenery assertion.
Clockwise rotation sign corrected for the actual world axes; native check now asserts its direction.

Initial Stone Eye browser sample fell in the intended laser flicker-off interval; the probe now checks actual emitted volley count before one rotation, while native tests require a real beam on the first tick.
Natural resident captures formerly stopped at ordinary encounter slots; they now include actually generated optional hazards without spawning substitutes.

The preceding browser run ended with Chromium target/context closed and no reported JavaScript/WebGL error; failure log retained. Final rerun avoids simultaneous native GPU captures. Cause of that browser termination is not established.
limitations: Chaos Card, Euthanasia, Little Horn, Infestation 2, Dead Eye, Fire Mind and D10-specific behavior need real item/effect producers; generic damage/death hooks are not those item implementations.
Cross Grimace bombed-door early-deactivation quirk and variant 11 plate precedence remain unverified/unimplemented. Variant 11 requires dedicated trap routing before gameplay reachability acceptance.
Vomit replacement probability/context, native random shot intervals, exact projectile/laser dimensions, hitbox and phase timings remain unmeasured.
Gaping Maws, Quake Grimaces and Bomb Grimace supply/dedicated encounter dependencies remain source-only.
Mixed-room balance, all-camera readability and controlled Linux/WASM performance acceptance remain open.

reproduction.browser: node web/enemy-port-test.cjs with Playwright, DEATHWARD_BROWSER and packaged server on port 8098
